# Knap - Markdown Templates from JSON and CSV

Curated by Skill Harbor: a small command-line templating skill from the kepano Obsidian skills collection. You give it a Markdown template (with {{ variable }}, filters, and logic) plus structured data, and it renders finished Markdown. One render makes one note; knap batch makes one file per CSV row, per object in a JSON array, or per JSON file in a folder. knap validate checks a template's syntax, filter names, and static arguments before rendering. This fiche covers ONLY skills/knap (SKILL.md, 102 lines at the pinned commit) and the Knap CLI it drives. Obsidian is NOT required by this skill, even though the collection is Obsidian-themed; the skill works on plain Markdown files anywhere. The licence and price of the Knap CLI tool itself were not verified, so no free or paid claim is made for the CLI. The optional Defuddle web-page-to-note pipeline was not tested. No install count is claimed: repo stars are collection-wide, never knap stars alone.
